protocol.objective: 100 log of future net-liquidation equity divided by current net-liquidation equity. Current orders and outstanding future exit cost are reconciled; unchanged holding does not pay a new exit fee every period.
protocol.matched_conditions: Same 47 known inputs, 11 actions, seed41, 1024 updates, 4096 replay, digest_chunks order, alias-consistent inference, $1000 allocation, source periods and modeled costs. Only supervised reward basis changes relative to the frozen alias-control checkpoints.
protocol.promotion: No automatic activation; later independent evaluation required
